definition.simple: A plant that traps and digests insects to get nutrients.
definition.academic: Plants that derive some or most of their nutrients from trapping and consuming animals or protozoans, typically insects and other arthropods.

common_misconceptions: Insectivorous plants don't do photosynthesis at all.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask them why a green plant might still need to eat insects (hint: poor soil).
